hypothesis: 2600 uniform task updates undertrain large endpoints; longer size-tempered training plus independent endpoint adaptation can improve learned representations
selection: Choose ONE variant/weight per task solely by mean paired scaffold-CV gain over the v24 neural branch, requiring >=2 of 3 nonnegative folds and positive mean >0.0001. Then veto if the exact v24 historical ensemble valid replay does not improve >0.0001; do not fall back to a different variant/weight using valid results.
cv_comparator: Exact cached v24 two-seed neural branch under identical fit/query indices; full historical ensemble OOF unavailable
valid_comparator: Reconstruct actual v24 full ensemble valid predictions with exact rank/raw fusion; historically reused and selection-biased
validation_groups: Global scaffold and nonisomeric identity separation across all tasks; train-only CV; exclude official-valid scaffold groups from all task fits for secondary valid
bootstrap: 250 paired scaffold-cluster resamples; descriptive and not post-selection-adjusted
